hypothesis: coins with higher trailing Amihud price impact per dollar volume earn higher subsequent cross-sectional returns on Binance USD-M perpetuals, beta-neutral, weekly-or-slower, after adapter costs and native funding
mechanism: compensation for liquidity provision: high price-impact coins carry inventory/immediacy risk that liquidity PROVIDERS are paid to bear; counterparty is price-insensitive flow and the convenience crowd clustered in liquid majors

feature_contract.bars: completed 15m base bars only (close + quote/dollar volume)
feature_contract.aggregate: daily UTC return and daily dollar volume
feature_contract.anchor_feature: AMIHUD_28D = mean over trailing 28d of daily_|r_i|/daily_dollar_volume_i, log-1p, cross-sectional rank
feature_contract.orthogonalisation_diagnostic: Amihud re-ranked within trailing 30d median dollar-volume terciles (size proxy); raw-vs-orthogonalised spread comparison declared pre-score
feature_contract.residualisation: rolling 90d daily beta vs BTC applied to book weights (beta-aware)
feature_contract.pit_lag: features from completed bars; 24h declared execution lag; weekly decision instant after freeze
feature_contract.funding_role: cost line only, never a signal input

anchor.name: ILLIQ-AMIHUD-28D-W
anchor.book: long most-illiquid quintile minus short most-liquid quintile, equal weight, dollar-neutral, beta-neutral

causal_negative_control.name: ILLIQ-AMIHUD-28D-W-INV
causal_negative_control.book: sign-inverted anchor (long most-liquid minus short most-illiquid)
causal_negative_control.falsification: any positive after-cost spread on the inverted book destroys the mechanism claim

schedule.turnover_rationale: slow 28d characteristic, persistent bucket membership, two bucket legs; A3 gate verifies floors on schedule artifacts before any scoring

falsification_conditions: anchor net spread negative (perp transfer fails)
anchor positive raw but ~0 after size-orthogonalisation (size effect relabelled)
A3 floors fail (base drag > 8%/yr, stressed > 12%/yr, holding < 3d, decisions > 60/365d, symbol turnover share > 25%)
cost_treatment: adapter taker fee + adverse-tick slippage floor per side, reused verbatim from GenericStrategyBase.rebalance_cost_between; stressed cell fee x1.5 + 2 ticks; native funding accrual via checked_funding_accrual over held spans
risks: generic tick-slippage floor understates true impact on the illiquid long leg (stressed cell is the pre-score margin)
size confound (mitigated by declared pre-score orthogonalisation diagnostic)
spot-sample-to-perp transfer must be re-earned (funding, native shorting, basis)
listing/survivorship handled fail-closed by staged snapshot coverage rules

reserved_seed_proximity.V11-SEED-DEFENSIVE-RESIDUAL-RISK: expected NEGATIVE book overlap (illiquid tail is high-residual-vol; this book is long it); no shared observable (no return-risk measure)
reserved_seed_proximity.V11-SEED-LOTTERY-MAX-SKEW: no shared observable (no MAX/skew/return-shape input); orthogonality verified by A7-N rho

ancestry.volume_usage_disclaimer: dollar volume is a deflator inside a slow 28d impact LEVEL, not a shock-continuation signal; opposite mechanism and 1/500th the decision frequency of the forbidden volume-shock family

required_fields: completed 15m bars (close, quote volume) per USD-M symbol in frozen staged snapshot

not_a_rescue: changes observable class (price impact per dollar volume), cadence (52 decisions/yr vs 6916 positions/fold) and mechanism (liquidity-provision compensation vs flow absorption/continuation); no rejected family is a special case; no rejected threshold re-tuned
